avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce procainamide levels and decrease antiarrhythmic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases procainamide concentrations and risk of toxicity including QT prolongation
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use; counsel on grapefruit avoidance

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive effects on cardiac contractility; theoretical risk of enhanced negative inotropy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased fatigue or dyspnea; coordinate supplementation with cardiologist

caution_supplements.name: Licorice root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential hypokalemia and sodium retention may increase arrhythmia risk and procainamide toxicity
caution_supplements.action: Limit use; monitor serum potassium and sodium levels

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases procainamide bioavailability and plasma concentrations, elevating toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; advise patient of all grapefruit-containing products to avoid

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive sodium intake may antagonize procainamide's antiarrhythmic effects and increase fluid retention
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderate sodium restriction consistent with cardiac guidelines

monitoring_notes: Monitor procainamide levels, ECG parameters (QT interval, PR duration), renal function, and acetylator status, as renal impairment and genetic polymorphisms in CYP2D6/acetylation significantly affect drug clearance. Watch for signs of lupus-like syndrome and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia) which can precipitate arrhythmias.
